content:
There is such a thing as the fullness of God, that a man can experience in there life here on Earth, this is what God made available for us the death, burial and Resurrection of Jesus Christ! It is not in God's nature to do a temporal or incomplete work, His nature is Perfection, when He comes in ones life, He comes in His fullness, when He saves, He saves to the utmost and brings all things into Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Sonship is a work of the Resurrection of Christ. We are brought into the very life of the resurrected Christ, it's does not come about by human effort, this is what Perfection is, it is the manifestation of the Godhead in the Earth! True sonship is the person of the Christ in the Earth, this is what creation is waiting for. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

All the works of God are permanent, anything temporary does not have God's fingerprint on it, He cannot give you something that can fail or be lost, His ways are Perfect, His solutions are permanent, Every Perfect gift comes from Him.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There are heights in God to which we have been called to that are far beyond man's ability to comprehend. The Holy Spirit in this time has brought us to a place beyond what we have known or become comfortable with, and the truth is, this reality is very different from what we have been used to. Perfection cannot be defined in the bounds of an imperfect system, we must yield to the Holy Spirit to show us the new way of functioning in God's Perfect reality.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The reality of life is always found in the laws that one is placed under, when you escape the laws that bind others you find a different reality. We don't all have the same view and reality of life, there are various realms of function that are available and give us different experiences. There is a Perfect reality God has made available for His people. Come up hither, escape the limitations of the world that others are bound by, Christ is our Perfection! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Excellence is not Perfection, Perfection is the full expression of the risen Christ in a man that affects all creation, this is the Power of His Resurrection in manifestation. Perfection is what happens when a man comes to rest, he is not striving with anyone or anything. He is as Jesus is. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God does not work to be how He is, anything that one is still working on shows that he or she not that way by default, one does not work to be how they are. God calls us to rest, this is the place where the fullness of God is made manifest without struggle, but rather it is the reality of how you are. Jesus is this Rest, He is Perfection! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God does not do things in part, all His works are Perfect, He doesn't do anything that is temporal, His truth is Perfect and defined. If you look close enough, you will see that anything temporal or partial, is done through agency and representation, but whenever you see Perfection it has God's fingerprint. You are called onto Perfection to know and experience Him as He is. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There are various realms in God, and each one has its own way of function, our experience with God and our influence on the Earth is dependent on the realm from which we manifest. Jesus is the Highest realm of existence, He is Perfection and He fills all in all, there is no realm that is outside His sphere of influence, He is the truth and reality of seamless union with God.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God's Perfect will for you is not to protect you or heal you, Perfection is you coming into the fullness of Christ, and becoming the protection for all Creation, to bring all things into the state of Christ. This is the reality of the resurrected Christ, He is not at the mercy of anything, but rather all things are made subject to Him. Come into Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a place or position that you attain, it is a state of being, a state that cannot be compromised or changed, it therefore cannot be attained by what one does. God pulls us into this state in Christ, it is the actualization of the person of the risen Christ in us. We come into the fullness of how He is.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What has been lost to time is can only be gained by the revelation of God who perfects all things that concern you. So far all we have known is the hope that we have in God for a bright or better future. In Perfection your past is not left out, the Resurrected Christ is not bound by time, His power manifests and is seen in every sphere of existence. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is a work of God, there is no human involvement in it, it does not have to do with ones will to be Perfect or attain Perfection, the truth is it cannot even be attained by faith. It is purely the will and preordaining of God the Father to bring all creation into Perfection. It is accomplished by the power that raised Jesus from the dead. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

When God is involved in something it is not a matter of probability, in Christ all the promises of God are yes and amen. There is only one possible outcome of Gods plan for your life, it is to come into the fullness of Christ, to be conformed into His exact Image. This is Perfection! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The realm of Perfection, is beyond what we have seen and known as reality, the systems and functions of men and nature crumble in it's wake. We have been preordained to live and manifest this reality of the risen Christ, a life where nothing wears out, a life of complete and permanent rest. This is the state called Christ! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What you believe about Christ is who He will be for you, if you believe Him to be a healer, He will heal you, if you believe Him to be a protector He will protect you. Now the reality of this is also that the protector will not heal or provide for you. All that has been known about God has been in part, in Perfection we See Him as He is; How He is, is not based on our need, rather it's based on His Reality and fullness. He is so much more than what we have heard or need Him to be, we must see Him as He is.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus did not come to get you through the rough patches of your life, salvation is way beyond that, the price Jesus paid was Perfect, He didn't do it just to get people off addictions and pains. The work of God was to bring Creation into Perfection; justification of mankind was the beginning of the process. When we fully come to to grips with how much Jesus did for us, we will understand that it is more than just a fix up job; He brought us Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Cast off the fear and embrace the Love of God for you, for he that fears has not been made Perfect in Love. In Perfection you are not battling with Fear, you have been made Perfect in Love, there is no place for fear and it's influence to ever come near you, for Perfect Live casts out all fear. Come unto Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The weight of the cross was not just to carry sin of men, was the place that guaranteed the liberty of all Creation. The Lamb of God was the ultimate payment to purchase all Creation. The sacrifice of Christ was Perfect, therefore His resurrection is Perfection to us who are born of God, and this life is the freedom for all Creation. It is through us that He shows forth His Love for all Creation.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

All the hope of mankind and creation was in the Man Jesus of Nazareth! Men looked to Him in hope that He would fulfil the plan and purposes of God in full. His death and suffering was full payment that satisfied all the conditions of the universe. Now in the resurrection there are no promises; Jesus the Risen Christ is not the Hope for humanity, He is the reality of the freedom from corruption for all creation, He is immortality and Life for all things.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is no such thing as Perfect Healing or Protection, Perfection does not deal with individual areas of ones life, Perfection is a state of Being as He is, it is not in parts.
The Perfection of all things is the Man Jesus Christ. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is nothing that can be added to Christ, He is Perfection. When you see that this is how God has made us, you will stop trying to get something to complete or satisfy you. Christ is Fullness, you cannot be in the State of Christ and still desire a blessing or prosperity or healing, In Him we have been made a life giving Spirit. This is Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The end of an Age is upon us, for some this brings so much fear and uncertainty but for us this is a time of so much joy and peace, because the systems and strategies of the world are all crumbling under the weight of the happenings in the world, but we have received a Kingdom that cannot be shaken. Only that which is Perfect shall stand.  
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The kingdom of God has come to take over, it doesn't negotiate term's of agreement with other nations, it is here to establish the theocratic rule. All creation willfully submits to its Creator once He is seen and made manifest. The Kingdom is the appearing of God and His Christ, His throne established above all.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Time is not a measure of life, Christ is. Jesus is the source and definition of life. Anyone outside Christ has no life and is bound to the expression of time. But Jesus is the vitality of Life, the peace and joy that brings fulfilment to all creation. Perfection is not affected by time, He is an unchanging reality of life.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Christ Jesus its not about having a great outcome, or even being successful in life, it's about being conformed into the image of Christ! This is Perfection, the Fullness of the risen Christ in a man.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

We thank God for the Cross, it is the initial place where fallen man and His situation was redeemed. But we are not products of the cross, we are God's inheritance in the Resurrection. We do not look to the cross, we seek those things with are above where we are seated with Christ far above. When we look to the cross the divine response is, "He ISN'T here He is risen" and "why do you seek the living among the dead". Perfection is in the Resurrection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is no such thing as "my sin" in Perfection, your cannot lay claim to any sin. Jesus Christ became sin for us, He took all the sin and its effects from man, and in the resurrection He gives us His life that has no part of sin, the resurrection life has no past. Christ is rised Perfect Holy immortal higher than the Heavens. In Perfection we have no past or future sin.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The demonstration of God's power has been seen throughout the ages in many forms, we have seen the power of the anointing, the power in the blood of Jesus, the power in the Name of Jesus etc, and it's so wonderful yet mankind is yet to experience the Power of the Resurrection. This is the Power that rised Jesus from the dead and brought about Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a revival, it is not a message. It is the reality of How Jesus is, it is bringing all Creation into it's original state, it is life and immortality, it is the reality and experience of Resurrection, an actual living manifestation of the ressurected Christ to all creation! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Perfection we bring all creation into it's rightful and original state. Perfection is not a new message or doctrine, it is the Original State of all creation, it is the place in which all things function as God purposed them to. Perfection is before all things, it is the reality of the Heart of God towards all things. That which is PERFECT is come! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Don't down grade Perfection to your level of experience or a man or woman you look up to it goes far beyond any human mind can phathom or think it is God's reality of all things. It is the God class and experience.. Perfection is Come
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Salvation is not the Endgame; Perfection is, it is the culmination of all things that were created into one head with is Christ! The resurrection is the place at which the reality of Perfection was made visible to all Creation, to fail to see Perfection is not to has a picture of the Power and Glory of the Resurrection! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In the Resurrection life, Jesus does not give us the power of attorney, the Power of His ressurrection changes the person or creature into the exact state of the Resurrected Christ Himself. This is the desire of the Father, He doesn't want us to merely carry or represent Him, we are to be an exact manifestation of How He is. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Resurrection of Christ is not a theme or a message, it should not be reduced merely to an important event in the Christian faith. The Resurrection is a State, it is the reality of all creation in Christ. It is the Power and Truth by which Creation is brought into Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

If Jesus did it, He showed us the path that we are to walk. Christ is the Way, He is not just the destination He is the also the Way to the destination that He Himself is. When Jesus rose from the dead, He showed us the path we are called to walk, this is the Revelation of the present truth, the Resurrection is the next phase of human reality and experience. It is not religious, it is the truth of all Creation. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Past does not have to be a prison of ones mistake, or the reason for ones present situation, when we come in Perfection the reality based on how Jesus is, Jesus is the Reality of our Past Present and Future, time find it's place in Him, He is the Manifestation of Perfection in time.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Perfection you don't look for a blessing or receive anything from God, we are made the very life and essence of How He is, God does not seek for or receive anything, He is the source from which all things come into Perfection. He is the Perfect state of All Creation!
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not found in written pages, Perfection is in the manifestation of the Risen Christ, as long as He is unseen there is no Perfection, it is His appearing that is Perfection. We have been called to this experience it is not a metaphoric manifestation, but we actually see Him as He is.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

One doesn't grow in Perfection, it does not happen in parts, or by process. Perfection is a state, it is the state of being as He is. This is the reality that God purposes for all creation, to manifest His life and nature. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is no price one can pay to come into Perfection, there is no sacrifice one can make to earn it! For it has no price, there is nothing that is equal in value to Perfection. It is the Manifestation of God Himself. God is the reality of Perfection, He brings all things into Himself.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Higher dimensions bring higher realities, certain things that were not acceptable in certain ages and dispensations become the way of life in the next era. It was once said no man can see God and live, in Perfection as we behold Him face to face, we are brought into Immortality and Life 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a message to be preached it is a life to be experienced, it is the fullness of God; His eternal plan and purpose for all Creation fulfilled in Christ.
It is a manifestation, a visible and undeniable reality.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is the manifestation of reality, it is Christ in Creation, real in the spirit and real in the physical; affecting all things in all realms, yet affected by none Himself. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Love is what Perfects all things, there is nothing that can escape it's reach, all things are brought into their fullness and highest potential in Love! Love is the manifestation of Perfection! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus desires us to manifest His life and Glory, it's not just about worshipping Him or serving Him. We were made to manifest how He is to all creation. Do not settle for a servants life, you were made for Sonship.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not taught, one cannot confess their way into it. Perfection comes by Birth, it is an instant event that one is born into, by the resurrection Power of God that raised Jesus from the dead. There is no process involved it works instantly, in a twinkling of an eye.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a once off top of the mountain experience, it is a permanent reality of unshakable truth. It has no comparison or opposite, it is the manifest reality of Christ, in the Past, Present and Future! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What Jesus did in His death is far beyond what has been preached or taught, He did not only die for human beings, He is the Lamb of God for all creation! He died a Perfect death, it was the end of all death, There is no more death in anything.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

To enter into Perfect life you must know the power and purpose of the Perfect death i.e. the death of Jesus Christ. Perfection is not the highest point of mortal life, it is the Life that is past death, life imperishable, life unchanging. It is a birth into the Ressurrection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*
